name.dum: Van seven trappen inden graet der gheesteliker minnen
name.en-US: The Seven Steps of the Ladder of Spiritual Love
name.pt-BR: Os Sete Degraus da Escada do Amor Espiritual

description.dum: Traktaat over zeven trappen van geestelijke liefde, geschreven voor Margriet van Meerbeke. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1861).
description.en-US: A treatise on the seven steps of spiritual love, written for Margaret of Meerbeke. The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1861). English: Mother St. Jerome, 1914, chapter for chapter.
description.pt-BR: Tratado sobre os sete degraus do amor espiritual, escrito para Margarida de Meerbeke. Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1861).

en-US.translator: Mother St. Jerome (Benedictine nun of Stanbrook?)

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 4: Dit is van ‧VII‧ trappen inden graet der gheesteliker minnen. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1861).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.

sources.edition: Love's Gradatory: The Book of the Seven Steps of Divine Love by Blessed John Ruysbroeck, translated by Mother St. Jerome (London: Burns & Oates, 1914).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan (research/sourcing/_scripts/ruusen_build.py); running heads and the page-foot scripture references removed. The translator's preface and introduction are not included.
